sentence: Mr. Li ____ (buy) a new computer for his son yesterday.
explain: yesterday 提示一般过去时，buy 的过去式为 bought。

sentence: Tom often ____ (go) to the library to read books on weekends.
explain: often 和主语 Tom 提示第三人称单数形式 goes。

sentence: Look! The children ____ (play) happily on the playground.
explain: Look 提示正在发生，主语是复数，用 are playing。

sentence: She has already ____ (finish) her homework, so she can watch TV now.
explain: has 与 already 构成现在完成时，后接过去分词 finished。

sentence: They ____ (visit) the science museum tomorrow morning.
explain: tomorrow 提示将来时，填 will visit 或 are going to visit。

sentence: The famous bridge ____ (build) by local workers fifty years ago.
point: 一般过去时的被动语态
explain: ago 提示过去时，主语与动词是被动关系，填 was built。

sentence: English ____ (speak) widely in international business today.
point: 一般现在时的被动语态
explain: 表示客观事实且为被动关系，主语是单数，填 is spoken。

sentence: I ____ (write) an email when my mother called me last night.
explain: when 引导的过去动作发生时，主句正在进行，填 was writing。

sentence: He got up early this morning in order to ____ (catch) the first bus.
explain: in order to 意为“为了”，后接动词原形 catch。

sentence: ____ (swim) in summer is a great way to keep healthy.
explain: 动词在句首作主语表示习惯或抽象动作，用动名词 swimming。

sentence: My sister enjoys ____ (listen) to light music before going to bed.
explain: enjoy doing sth. 是固定用法，填 listening。

sentence: The students decided ____ (clean) the classroom together after class.
explain: decide to do sth. 为固定搭配，填 to clean。

sentence: I found a wallet ____ (drop) on the ground near the gate.
explain: wallet 与 drop 是被动关系，用过去分词 dropped 作宾补。

sentence: Our English teacher told us ____ (read) aloud every morning.
explain: tell sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，填 to read。

sentence: Thank you for ____ (help) me with my math problem.
explain: for 为介词，后面接动名词形式 helping。

sentence: The train moved ____ (slow) through the thick fog.
explain: 修饰动词 moved 需用副词形式 slowly。

sentence: Thomas Edison was a great American ____ (invent).
explain: 不定冠词 a 修饰表示人的单数名词，填 inventor。

sentence: Money cannot always bring true ____ (happy) to people.
explain: 作动词 bring 的宾语，需用名词形式 happiness。

sentence: The local police gave us some ____ (help) advice on road safety.
explain: 修饰名词 advice 需用形容词形式 helpful（有帮助的）。

sentence: This movie is very ____ (interest), and many people like it.
explain: 修饰事物 this movie 具有令人感兴趣的特质，用 interesting。

sentence: Please check your test paper ____ (careful) before handing it in.
explain: 修饰动词 check 应用副词 carefully。

sentence: Eating fresh vegetables and fruit is good for your ____ (healthy).
explain: your 后接名词，healthy 的名词形式是 health。

sentence: Many ____ (child) are flying kites in the park today.
explain: many 修饰可数名词复数，child 的不规则复数是 children。

sentence: The yellow car is much ____ (cheap) than the black one.
explain: than 提示比较级，cheap 的比较级为 cheaper。

sentence: Mount Qomolangma is the ____ (high) mountain in the world.
explain: 范围 in the world 提示最高级，the 后填 highest。

sentence: Practice more, and your spoken English will become much ____ (good).
explain: much 修饰比较级，good 的比较级为 better。

sentence: Jack took off ____ (he) coat because it was too warm inside.
explain: 修饰名词 coat 需用形容词性物主代词 his。

sentence: The little girl is able to dress ____ (her) now.
explain: 主语为 girl，dress oneself 表示自己穿衣，填 herself。

sentence: Give ____ a bottle of water, please. I am very thirsty.
explain: give 为动词，结合后句 I 可知此处用第一人称宾格 me。

sentence: David wants to be ____ engineer when he grows up.
explain: engineer 以元音音素开头，表示“一名”用 an。

sentence: She bought ____ useful dictionary in the bookstore yesterday.
explain: useful 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，泛指单数名词用 a。

sentence: The sun rises in ____ east and sets in the west.
explain: 方位词 east 前通常加定冠词 the。

sentence: Our school sports meeting will be held ____ October 15th.
explain: 具体到某一天的时间前面介词用 on。

sentence: He is very confident and proud ____ his achievements.
explain: be proud of 为固定短语，意为“为……感到骄傲”。

sentence: Many students in our city go to school ____ bus every day.
explain: by bus 为固定搭配，表示“乘公共汽车”。

sentence: Hurry up, ____ you will miss the beginning of the movie.
explain: “祈使句 + or + 陈述句”，or 表示“否则”。

sentence: ____ it was raining heavily, the postman still delivered the letters on time.
explain: 前后句为让步转折关系，句首用 Although 或 Though。

sentence: The woman ____ is talking with our teacher is Mary's mother.
explain: 先行词 The woman 指人且在从句中作主语，填 who 或 that。

sentence: I really like the present ____ my best friend gave me.
explain: 先行词 the present 指物且在从句中作宾语，填 which 或 that。

sentence: He told me ____ he would study abroad next year.
explain: 从句句意和成分完整，起连接作用且无实际词义用 that。
